ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.SSV_PersonaServiceSupervisor = False, OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Solved") ), SSV_Linear_Ticket_Status__c <> "Done", OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupport", RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_CustomerSupportEmergencyAfterHours", RecordType.DeveloperName = "SSV_OwnershipTransfer") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Status Cannot be moved to Closed or Solved until Related Linear Ticket is still Open
